confidence.reason: Page count and CMS choice are stated; content volume and hosting ownership are assumed.

objectives: Replace the outdated brochure site with a mobile-friendly site the marketing team can edit
understanding.scope_summary: Informational website of about 8 pages on a CMS, one enquiry form, basic SEO and analytics setup, go-live on client-provided hosting.

answered_questions.answer: Client provides hosting and domain access before build starts.
answered_questions.effect_on_estimate: No cloud provisioning tasks; deployment task only.

gaps_assumed.gap: Number of blog/news posts to migrate
gaps_assumed.assumption: No content migration; client enters content through the CMS.

requirement_items.ref: Scope — Site map: Home, About, Services, Contact
requirement_items.text: Home, About, Services and Contact pages
Navigation and page hierarchy agreed before design
Responsive on current desktop, tablet and mobile browsers
Marketing team can edit page content without a developer
One enquiry form emailing the sales inbox
On-page SEO basics, analytics and search console configured
Deployment to client hosting with SSL
No online sales or payment integration
Content writing and photography provided by the client

modules.description: Information architecture and visual design of the page templates.

tasks.title: Information architecture and requirement sign-off
tasks.delivers: Site map, navigation model, page inventory and content checklist agreed with the client.

tasks.title: UI/UX design of page templates
tasks.delivers: Responsive wireframes and visual design for the home page and three inner-page templates, one revision round.

modules.description: CMS setup, templates, enquiry form, SEO and analytics.

tasks.title: CMS setup and theme foundation
tasks.delivers: CMS installed and configured, base theme, editable menus, roles for the editor, media library setup.

tasks.title: Page templates and responsive build
tasks.delivers: Home page and three inner-page templates built to design, editable blocks, cross-browser and responsive checks on the agreed browser list.
tasks.notes: Kept whole: template and editable-block logic are coupled.

tasks.title: Enquiry form with email routing
tasks.delivers: One validated enquiry form with spam protection, stored submissions and email to the sales inbox.

tasks.title: SEO basics and analytics setup
tasks.delivers: Page titles and metadata, XML sitemap, redirects list, analytics and search console configured.

tasks.title: Deployment, SSL and go-live
tasks.delivers: Production deployment on client hosting, SSL, DNS cut-over support, post-launch smoke checks.

tasks.title: Development and staging environments with version control
tasks.delivers: Repository, staging site and a repeatable deployment routine.
tasks.notes: Not stated; needed to review and release the build safely.

tech_stack.alternative: Strapi headless CMS with a static frontend
tech_stack.rationale: Marketing editors need simple page editing and a large plugin ecosystem.
tech_stack.effort_impact: Headless alternative adds roughly 25–40 % build effort.

tech_stack.rationale: Hosting ownership assumed to sit with the client.
tech_stack.effort_impact: Managed hosting adds provisioning and monitoring tasks.

overheads.name: Contingency
overheads.reason_if_changed: Client content delivery and approval turnaround are unconfirmed (risk R-1); hosting access is assumed (risk R-2).

type_applicability.reason: CMS-managed schema; no custom data model.
Covered by the QA and UAT overhead percentages.
Standard hardening inside CMS setup; no compliance controls requested.
Content migration not in scope (see gaps assumed).
Covered by the documentation overhead percentage.
Covered by the PM overhead percentage.

timeline_notes.client_dependency_lead_time: 1 week for final content before build; 1 week for UAT feedback.

cost_drivers.sizing_assumption: Under a few hundred enquiries per month

maintenance_recommendation.reasoning: Small CMS site; flexible hours cover updates and minor edits.

assumptions.text: The client provides final content and images before the build phase starts.
No content migration; the client enters content through the CMS.
One design revision round per template.

exclusions: Off-page SEO and social media management

client_dependencies.impact_if_late: Build and go-live slip day for day.

client_dependencies.dependency: Single point of contact with 48-hour approvals

risks.risk: Client content arrives late or in several rounds.
risks.mitigation: Content checklist at sign-off; freeze date in the plan.

risks.risk: Hosting is not ready or restricts required plugins.
risks.mitigation: Hosting checklist in the first week.

re_estimation_triggers: More than 12 pages or extra templates

optional_addons.item: Content migration from the existing site
optional_addons.task_hint: Depends on page and post count
